# dna account

Reseller account: balance and transactions.

## dna account get

```
dna account get [flags]
```

Show the reseller account and its TRY/USD balances.

Returns the reseller ID, name, group and the current TRY and USD balances. This is also the cheapest
way to verify that credentials work.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/deposit/accounts/me`
- **Returns:** `AccountDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema account.get` (MCP tool: `account_get`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

Aliases: `balance`, `me`

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
# Show balances
dna account get
# Print only the USD balance
dna account get --jq .usdBalance
```

## dna account transactions

```
dna account transactions [flags]
```

List balance transactions (charges, refunds, deposits).

Pages through the balance ledger. Filter by date range, transaction type, product type and charge
direction.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/deposit/transactions`
- **Returns:** `PagedResultDto<AccountTransactionDto>`
- **Schema:** `dna schema account.transactions` (MCP tool: `account_transactions`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--transaction-types` | strings | Only these transaction types (name or number, repeatable) [1=Register, 2=Renew, 3=Transfer, 4=Restore, 5=Deposit, 6=Backorder, 7=Refund, 8=Deduction, 9=PreRegister, 10=Shopping, 11=ResellerPayment, 12=InternalTransfer] |
| `--product-types` | strings | Only these product types (name or number, repeatable) [1=Domain, 2=SSL, 3=Deposit, 4=DomainTrustee, 5=Hosting, 6=OwnerChange] |
| `--account-currency-types` | strings | Account currency types (repeatable) |
| `--charge-type` | string | Add (credits) or Subtract (debits) [0=Add, 1=Subtract] |
| `--trace-id` | string | Trace id |
| `--description` | string | Description |
| `--amount` | float64 | Amount |
| `--start-date` | string | From this time (RFC 3339, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) |
| `--end-date` | string | Until this time (RFC 3339) |
| `--filter-text` | string | Filter text |
| `--remaining-day` | int | Remaining day |
| `--sorting` | string | Sorting |
| `--skip-count` | int | Skip count |
| `--max-result-count` | int | Max result count |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
| `--all` |  | Fetch every page and return all items |

**Examples**

```bash
# Registrations this month
dna account transactions --start-date 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z --transaction-types Register
```
